sourceFiles.pdf: Star Wars Saga Edition - Legacy Era Campaign Guide.pdf

process.discoveryMethod: Searched all 793,776 bytes of the DJVU text layer for vehicle-type headers, CL statblocks, vehicles and station references, ship subtype lines, and the vehicle statblock index. Classified the 47 standalone type header matches, reconciled the 39 inherited canonical spacecraft including two historically catalogued named ship variants; 10 other standalone vehicle/statblock claims were visually verified in source-page renders. Independently rendered all 225 original PDF pages into twelve numbered 20-page contact sheets to scan for unusual layouts or vehicle blocks absent from OCR.
process.textLayerCaveat: Original 225-page PDF is scanned without selectable text; the original raster page renders control printed names, types, CL and page. DJVU TXT is discovery/navigation only.
process.printedToPdfMapping: Zero-based original PDF page index equals the printed page; one-based physical PDF page number equals printed page + 1.
sectionsSwept: Front matter, species, heroic traits, and organizations
Chapter VI: Vehicles and Starships, pp80-92
Refitted and antiquated vehicle templates, pp101-102
Galactic Alliance starships and special installations, pp141-153
Galactic Empire vehicles and spacecraft, pp184-191
The Fringe: The Wheel, p205, and Fringe starships, pp218-220
process.exhaustivenessCaveat: Two-tier scan: full searchable DjVu text plus full PDF contact sheets, with high-resolution original PDF confirmation of all ten nonship candidates. Text recognition defects are possible; no unsupported entries were invented.

identityDecisions.subject: Golan VIII and Rendili Star Drive Mobile Spacedock 220
identityDecisions.reason: Both statblocks explicitly print 'Colossal (station) space station'; hyperdrives and extremely slow flight do not reclassify them as capital ships or collapse them into inherited ships.

identityDecisions.subject: Carried speeders, walkers, work pods, starfighters, and shuttles
identityDecisions.reason: Generic carried-craft quantities and class names do not create separate independent source statblock identities.

identityDecisions.subject: The Raider, other named appearances of ship classes, and modified narrative vessels
identityDecisions.reason: Flavor uses and owner names of existing spacecraft are not independently printed statblocks; the source's 39 historical identity claims are retained without duplicated references.

identityDecisions.subject: Legacy refitted and antiquated vehicle templates
identityDecisions.reason: General templates modify existing vehicles; no specific additional vehicle-model statblocks provided by those rules.

identityDecisions.subject: Yuuzhan Vong living vehicle rules and dovin basal weapon options
identityDecisions.reason: Vehicle ecology/equipment rules do not provide an independently named statblock publication identity.

identityDecisions.subject: Vehicle illustrations and military narrative
identityDecisions.reason: Artwork, deployment narrative, encounter mentions and product names without an accompanying full printed vehicle statblock are not publication claims.
